title: Framework workflow-tool publisher remains blocked until its dedicated GitHub App is configured
title_de: Framework-Workflow-Tool-Publisher bleibt bis zur Konfiguration seiner dedizierten GitHub-App blockiert
profile: Framework Update pinned workflow tools runs #1 and #2
affected_symbols: Mint repository-limited workflow publisher App token
observed_behavior: Historical run 30190898961 on Framework master 7e9a560f3acda65510c93f649b6ed4977e4cd6cb passed resolver and validator, then GitHub rejected the native github.token workflow-file push. Source remediation PR #46 was merged as c27c644e088904b71b8380d16ee34f1b36f2c001. Current run 30195702432 (run #2, workflow_dispatch) on that master SHA again passed resolver and validator but failed before token issuance at Mint repository-limited workflow publisher App token because the client-id input is empty. Name-only repository variable and secret inventories returned no names.
expected_behavior: After a dedicated GitHub App is installed only for this Framework repository and its client-ID variable and private-key secret are configured, a validated candidate that changes an allowlisted workflow pin publishes only the fixed maintenance branch and creates or updates exactly one matching Draft PR, while resolver and validator remain read-only and token-free.
impact: Automated publication of reviewed immutable Action/tool maintenance updates remains unavailable until the external App configuration is completed. The failure must not be bypassed by weakening pins, validation, scope checks, credential isolation, or default-branch protection.
preconditions: Framework default-branch updater run reaches the publisher after resolver and validator complete successfully.
The publisher is configured to mint the dedicated repository-limited GitHub App token.
A later candidate may change an allowlisted .github/workflows/* path.
reproduction: rtk proxy -- gh run view 30195702432 --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework --log-failed
rtk proxy -- gh variable list --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework
rtk proxy -- gh secret list --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework

evidence.command: rtk proxy -- gh run view 30190898961 --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework --json ...; rtk proxy -- gh run view 30190898961 --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework --log-failed; rtk proxy -- gh api ...update-workflow-tools.yml?ref=master; rtk proxy -- gh secret list --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework
evidence.exit_code: 0 for metadata/source/secret inventory; 1 for failed job log

evidence.command: rtk proxy -- gh run list ...; rtk proxy -- gh run view 30195702432 --json ...; rtk proxy -- gh run view 30195702432 --log-failed; rtk proxy -- gh variable list ...; rtk proxy -- gh secret list ...; rtk proxy -- git show origin/master:.github/workflows/update-workflow-tools.yml

root_cause: The historical native-token authority gap was fixed in source by merged PR #46. The current workflow correctly fails closed before issuing a token because repository variable WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_CLIENT_ID is absent. The private-key secret, dedicated App installation, and exact App permissions cannot be verified until the owner configures them.
proposed_remediation: A repository owner must configure and install a dedicated GitHub App only on Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework with Contents: write, Pull requests: write, and Workflows: write; then add repository variable WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_CLIENT_ID and repository secret WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY without exposing the key. Rerun the updater and verify the constrained maintenance branch and matching Draft PR. Do not add a github.token or personal-token fallback.
acceptance_criteria: The dedicated App is installed only on this Framework repository with Contents: write, Pull requests: write, and Workflows: write; no credential value reaches source, evidence, logs, resolver, or validator.
Repository variable WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_CLIENT_ID and secret WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY are configured by an authorized owner without exposing the private key.
Master retains the pinned create-github-app-token source and has no github.token or GITHUB_TOKEN publishing fallback.
A new updater run pushes only the constrained maintenance branch and creates or updates exactly one matching Draft PR.
The resulting Draft PR remains within the validated allowlisted candidate surface and master remains unchanged by the updater.
validation_plan: Inspect master update-workflow-tools.yml for the pinned App-token path and absence of a publishing-token fallback.
Verify the authorized App installation and the name-only repository variable/secret inventory without reading credential values.
Rerun the updater and verify constrained branch plus matching Draft PR creation without changing master directly.
regression_tests: Merged PR #46 current-master source and successful master push workflows
Updater CI-security contract suite and workflow-action-pin validators from the merged source remediation
legitimate_control_tests: A candidate including a workflow-pin update creates the constrained Draft PR without changing master or exposing the publishing credential.
dependencies: Current explicit repository-owner authorization for GitHub App installation and Actions variable/secret configuration.
Repository-limited GitHub App with the required workflow-file write authority.
blocked_by: Repository variable WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_CLIENT_ID is absent; run #2 fails before token issuance with a non-empty client-id input error.
Name-only repository Actions-secret inventory is empty, so WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY is not configured.
Dedicated GitHub App installation and exact permissions are unverified and require repository-owner configuration.

source_remediation.hosted_status_at_receipt: all normal PR checks passed on 781b5603975369dd9b9a1661edc417dd37f5dfa7; the three advisory jobs were expected skips. Initial head 3b3a7adaf95bf41682b010785ecd624ebf906730 failed Python quality only because Ruff required two mechanical formatting changes. All six merge-triggered master push workflows on c27c644e088904b71b8380d16ee34f1b36f2c001 passed.
source_remediation.remaining_external_prerequisite: Repository owner must configure a repository-limited GitHub App installation with Contents, Pull requests, and Workflows write permission plus WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_CLIENT_ID variable and WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY secret, then validate a workflow-file updater candidate.

history.detail: The historical publisher push was rejected for missing native GitHub App Workflows: write authority.
PR #46 merged the source-only repository-limited App-token boundary as c27c644e088904b71b8380d16ee34f1b36f2c001.
Run 30195702432 failed closed before token issuance because WORKFLOW_UPDATER_APP_CLIENT_ID is empty; name-only variable and secret inventories are empty.

The current user explicitly accepted this exact residual risk for local archive disposition. The missing App/variable/secret external configuration is retained without any credential, setting, fallback, or technical-closure claim.
